'''2001 Genghis Con tournament (17 February, evening)''' was a Star Wars CCG local (convention) held at Genghis Con, Denver, CO on 17 February 2001. It is known from Jason Keen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1811">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-27-denver-co-genghis-con-2-17-01-nightfalld1811/ denver-co-genghis-con-2-17-01-nightfall], DeckTech (Jason "Qui" Keen, 27 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-27-denver-co-genghis-con-2-17-01-nightfalld1811/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Genghis Con, Denver, CO
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 9
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]<ref name="tr-d1903" />
